title: Fiction-Publisher book configuration (config.yml)
description: Metadata and build settings for a Fiction-Publisher book project. Empty values are allowed (they are treated as not set).

seriesBook.description: Books to list on the series ("Also Available") page.

title-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted title for PDF output (overrides title).

subtitle-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted subtitle for PDF output (overrides subtitle).

link.description: Store link for the book (used in the Amazon ePub).

title-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted title (overrides title on the title and half-title pages of PDF output). A raggedrighttitle environment is available for multi-line titles.

title-page-top-margin.description: Space above the title on the title page (default is 4cm).

main-font.description: Main body font for PDF output (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name). Default is Cochineal.

main-font-bold.description: Bold variant of main-font (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name). Needed when main-font is a font file.

main-font-italic.description: Italic variant of main-font (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name). Needed when main-font is a font file.

main-font-bold-italic.description: Bold italic variant of main-font (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name). Needed when main-font is a font file.

title-font.description: Font for the book title on the title and half-title pages (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name).

title-font-pointsize.description: Font size of the title in PDF output (default is 50).

subtitle-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted subtitle (overrides subtitle on the title page of PDF output).

author-font.description: Font for the author's name on the title page (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name).

author-by-header.description: The "By" label above the author on the title page (default is blank).

text.description: A unique (version 4) UUID for your ebook.

cover-image.description: Path to the ePub cover image, relative to the book's folder (e.g., images/cover.jpg).

copyright-page.description: Copyright page template (from Pandoc/templates/copyright). Default is creative-commons.

contributors.description: People who contributed to the book.

cover-artist.description: Who created the art of your book cover.

illustrator.description: Who did the interior illustrations (appears on the title page).

rights.description: A single sentence regarding the licensing of your book (used as EPUB metadata only).

paperback-isbn-13.description: Optional 13-digit ISBN of your paperback book.

hardcover-isbn-13.description: Optional 13-digit ISBN of your hardcover book.

epub-isbn-13.description: Optional 13-digit ISBN of your epub book.

paperback-isbn-10.description: Optional 10-digit ISBN of your paperback book.

hardcover-isbn-10.description: Optional 10-digit ISBN of your hardcover book.

epub-isbn-10.description: Optional 10-digit ISBN of your epub book.

first-paperback-date.description: Publication date of the first paperback edition.

lcc-info-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted Library of Congress Cataloging-in-Publication Data (PDF copyright page).

lcc-info-html.description: HTML-formatted Library of Congress Cataloging-in-Publication Data (ePub copyright page).

impression-line-years.description: Year part of the printer line (years run right-to-left, usually 2-digit).

impression-line-printings.description: Print-run part of the printer line (numbers run left-to-right).

praise.description: Review quotes for a praise page at the front of the book. Quotation marks are added for you.

source.description: Who said it (Markdown), e.g., Jane Smith, author of *The Long Rain*.

praise-title.description: The praise page's heading. Default is Praise for followed by the title.

epigraph.description: Optional quote shown on a page before the first chapter.

epigraph-source.description: Who or what the epigraph is from.

epigraph-quote.description: false to hide the large opening quote mark beside the epigraph (default is true).

foreword.description: Foreword text (Markdown), usually written by someone other than the author.

foreword-author.description: Who wrote the foreword, shown as its sign-off.

foreword-title.description: The foreword's heading (e.g., Vorwort). Default is Foreword.

preface.description: Preface text (Markdown), written by the author.

preface-signoff.description: The preface's sign-off (e.g., the author's initials or the place and date it was written).

preface-title.description: The preface's heading (e.g., Préface). Default is Preface.

maps.description: Maps shown just before the first chapter. They are printed to the edge of the page, so the print PDF needs bleed set to true.

image.description: Path to the map, relative to the book's folder (e.g., images/map.png). Use a grayscale image for a black-and-white print interior.

image-epub.description: Path to the ePub's map, such as a color version (e.g., images/map-color.png). Default is image.

title.description: The map's name, shown under it in the ePub.

spread.description: true to print the map across a left and right page (default is false).

cast.description: Cast of characters, shown just before the first chapter. Characters can be grouped, such as by family or faction.

group.description: The group's heading (e.g., House Varenne). Leave out for an ungrouped list.

name.description: The character's name, shown in small caps.

description.description: A short description of the character (Markdown).

cast-title.description: The cast of characters' heading (e.g., Dramatis Personae). Default is Cast of Characters.

content-note.description: Optional note to the reader about difficult themes (Markdown), shown on its own page just before the first chapter.

content-note-title.description: The content note's heading (e.g., A Note to the Reader). Default is Content Note.

toc.description: Whether to include a table of contents in the print output.

toc-title.description: Header text for the table of contents.

toc-depth.description: How many heading levels the print table of contents shows: 0 for chapters only, 1 to also show sections (headings marked with ##), and so on.

series-header.description: Header on the series page (default is "Also Available").

colophon.description: Whether to include a colophon page (typesetting information) in the print output.

author-bio-title.description: The author biography's heading. Default is About the Author.

glossary.description: Glossary of terms, shown right after the story. Terms appear in the order listed and can be grouped, such as by places or magic.

group.description: The group's heading (e.g., Places). Leave out for an ungrouped list.

term.description: The term, shown in bold small caps.

pronunciation.description: How to say the term (e.g., EE-thur).

glossary-title.description: The glossary's heading (e.g., Lexicon). Default is Glossary.

call-to-action.description: A note asking readers to leave a review or join a newsletter (Markdown), signed by the author and shown right after the story.

call-to-action-title.description: The call to action's heading (e.g., Enjoyed the Book?). Default is Before You Go.

call-to-action-links.description: The call to action's links, shown as buttons in the ePub and as web addresses in print.

label.description: The button's text (e.g., Leave a Review).

link.description: The web address. Short addresses work best in print.

link-amazon.description: The web address used in the Amazon ePub (e.g., the book's Amazon review page). Default is link.

afterword-title.description: The afterword's heading (e.g., Nachwort). Default is Afterword.

acknowledgments-title.description: The acknowledgments' heading (e.g., Remerciements). Default is Acknowledgments.

reading-group-guide.description: Reading group discussion questions, as a numbered Markdown list.

reading-group-guide-title.description: The reading group guide's heading. Default is Reading Group Guide.

reading-group-subtitle.description: The subheading above the reading group questions. Default is Questions and Topics for Discussion.

reading-group-intro.description: Introduction shown above the reading group questions (Markdown).

afterword-flourish.description: pgfornament number of the flourish above the afterword's sign-off, or none to leave it out (PDF only). Default is none.

excerpt-title.description: Title of the book that the excerpt is from.

excerpt-heading.description: The excerpt's heading when excerpt-title is not set. Default is Excerpt.

excerpt-preview.description: The line above the excerpt's title. Default is A Preview of.

excerpt-closing.description: The line that ends the excerpt. Default is To be continued…

backmatter-flourish.description: pgfornament number of the flourish that closes the acknowledgments and excerpt, or none to leave it out (PDF only). Default is 88.

excerpt-note.description: Line shown under the excerpt's title, such as "Coming Soon".

paper-height.description: Paper height for print output (default paper size is 6x9 inches).

top-margin.description: Top margin in the print output (headers are inside the text body).

bottom-margin.description: Bottom margin in the print output.

inner-margin.description: Inner (gutter) margin in the print output.

outer-margin.description: Outer margin in the print output.

font-size.description: Body font size in points for print output (default is 11). Large print is usually 16 or more.

line-spacing.description: Line spacing for print output, as a multiple of the font's normal spacing (default is 1.3).

bleed.description: true to add a 0.125in bleed to the outside, top, and bottom edges of the print PDF, for artwork that reaches the edge of the page (default is false).

fancy-chapter.description: Chapter heading style from the fncychap package (PDF only). Overrides chapter-heading.

chapter-heading.description: Custom chapter heading theme (from Pandoc/templates/chapter-heading). Default is default.

chapter-image.description: Path to artwork shown above every chapter heading, relative to the book's folder (e.g., images/chapter.png). Not shown in the PDF when fancy-chapter is used.

chapter-image-epub.description: Path to the ePub's chapter heading artwork, such as a PNG with transparency (e.g., images/chapter-epub.png). Default is chapter-image.

chapter-image-width.description: Width of the chapter heading artwork (e.g., 2in or 50mm). Default is 1.5in.

chapter-name.description: The word used for "Chapter" in chapter headings, running headers, and the ePub labels of chapters with no title (e.g., Kapitel). Default is Chapter.

part-name.description: The word used for "Part" on part pages (e.g., Teil). Default is Part.

chapter-number-words.description: Spell out chapter numbers in PDF headings and running headers (e.g., Chapter One). Default is false.

drop-cap-style.description: Drop cap style for the first letter of each chapter (PDF only).

page-number-position.description: Where page numbers appear (PDF only). Default is header.

running-head-chapter-number.description: true to show "Chapter N --" before the chapter's title in the running header (PDF only). A chapter with no title always shows its number. Default is false.

drop-cap-color.description: Color of the drop cap, as a basic or named xcolor color (PDF only). Default is black.

scene-separator-latex.description: LaTeX code to replace *** between scenes (PDF output).

scene-separator-html.description: HTML code to replace *** between scenes (ePub output).

hyphenation-exceptions.description: Space-separated list of hyphenation exceptions (PDF only). A word without internal hyphens (e.g., McKinley) is never split across a line. A word with hyphens (e.g., man-u-script) marks allowed break points. Useful for character names.

no-hyphenate-list.description: Deprecated alias for hyphenation-exceptions. Kept for backward compatibility.

header-includes.description: Raw content to embed in the template's header (e.g., LaTeX commands).

unnumbered-chapters.description: Semicolon-separated list of chapter folder names (without the number prefix) that are unnumbered, such as a prologue. These aren't labeled or counted as numbered chapters. Default is Prologue; Epilogue.

emphasis-check.description: Semicolon-separated list of phrases that should be italicized (a warning is logged if they aren't).

copyedit.description: Outline the sections, show marginal notes, and mark lines that stick out past the margin in the print output (useful with CriticMarkup).

build-draft.description: false to not build a draft copy (default is true).

build-epub.description: false to not build an ePub file (default is true).

build-amazon-epub.description: false to not build the Amazon KDP ePub (default is true).

build-print.description: false to not build a PDF file (default is true).

pdf-x.description: true to make the print PDF PDF/X-1a:2001 compliant, which IngramSpark asks for and KDP prefers (default is false).
